title: The Look of an Awakening World

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Dangerous adventurer's plane that has come alive and is lashing out at the explorers who plunder it.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: Fickle force of Zendikar that makes off-trail travel deadly.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Elf planeswalker who has an affinity for the Roil and is riding high on Zendikar's agitation; the narrator's elf guide left to become one of her Chosen.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker who, like many others, has left Zendikar.

entities.name: Mount Valakut
entities.description: Volcanic peak on Zendikar casting a flame shadow and a pyroclastic flow.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: Region of Zendikar where the narrator's main equipment cache lies in a hedron-laden grassland.

entities.name: Greypelt
entities.description: Usual hangout on Zendikar, now conspicuously empty.

entities.name: Kazandu
entities.description: Usual hangout on Zendikar, now conspicuously empty.

entities.name: North Hada
entities.description: Usual hangout on Zendikar, now conspicuously empty.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: People of Zendikar terrorized by an elemental that was once the narrator's lair site.

entities.name: Chosen of Nissa
entities.description: Elves honored to serve Nissa Revane.

entities.name: Abyssal Persecutor
entities.description: Demon thought of as the perfect Faustian demon.

events.summary: The narrator laments that Zendikar has come alive and turned against adventurers, forcing a start over.
The narrator learns a tectonic plate is shambling toward their main equipment cache in Tazeem, dooming it.
events.quote: now I hear there's suddenly a tectonic plate shambling its way across the area

events.summary: The narrator's intended lair site becomes an elemental and goes off to terrorize some kor.
The narrator's elf guide leaves to become one of Nissa Revane's Chosen.
events.quote: Ever since my elf guide left me to become one of her Chosen

relations.note: has an affinity for the Roil
relations.quote: She's got a kind of affinity for the Roil, I hear
